work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief X to Bishop Carlo of Concordia (address LF1578–1579) absolves him and permits episcopal functions despite blindness; LF1639 → LF1645 across running title LF1642; complete 20 February 1835 closing LF1645–1648. Own provenance LF1711 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF1582–1582; the source closing at LF1645–1648 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima februarii millesimo octin- gentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno: quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
